description: Defines the StatusReportPage class for rendering a Drupal status report page element, including methods for generating general info, counters, and requirements.

classes.name: StatusReportPage
classes.description: A Drupal render element class for displaying a system status report page.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns rendering info including theme and pre-render callbacks.

methods.name: preRenderGeneralInfo
methods.description: Prepares general info section, processes requirements, and adds classes to cron requirement descriptions.

methods.name: preRenderCounters
methods.description: Creates counters for errors, warnings, and checked items based on requirements severity.

methods.name: preRenderRequirements
methods.description: Prepares the requirements section with attached libraries.
